en.title: Lock Acquire/Release Log Checker
en.description:
Each event is ACQUIRE lock or RELEASE lock. Locks must be released in the reverse order of acquisition; a lock that is already held cannot be acquired again, and a lock that is not held cannot be released. Return the 1-based index of the first erroneous event; if no event is erroneous but some lock is still held at the end, return the number of events + 1; otherwise return 0.

The input/output protocol and the limits marked as 'added by this site' were compiled by this site; limits not given in the original problem are not treated as part of the original source.
en.input: The first line contains n; each of the next n lines is ACQUIRE name or RELEASE name. Added by this site: 0≤n≤200000, and name is an ASCII identifier without whitespace.
en.output: Output the index of the first error, n+1 in the dangling case, or 0.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm idea, proof of correctness, and complexity.
